IndiGo appoints Willie Walsh as CEO, plans global expansion

IndiGo has appointed former IATA chief Willie Walsh as its new Chief Executive Officer. Walsh, who previously led British Airways, assumes charge succeeding Pieter Elbers. His mandate includes leading the airline's global expansion, international network growth, and long-term strategy. The airline is marking 20 years of operations and aims for a bigger global push, targeting diaspora traffic through India. Walsh has stated his intention to rebuild customer trust and make IndiGo the 'airline of choice' based on its service.
